description: This file defines the QuizzesService class responsible for fetching quiz data from a backend API in a Flutter/Dart project. It includes methods to retrieve a list of quizzes through an ApiClient instance.

classes.name: QuizzesService
classes.description: A service class that provides methods to interact with quiz data from the backend API.

methods.name: listQuizzes
methods.description: Fetches and returns a list of quizzes as a list of maps. Handles different data formats received from the API.
